name: AEZY
description: Lightweight performance fabric. Breathable, fast-drying and air-feel soft. Engineered for movement and everyday climate control, with elastic recovery that stays stable after long wear.

name: AEZY COTTON
description: The AEZY system with a cotton touch. The natural, familiar feel of cotton on the skin, with the easy breathability AEZY is known for. Made for long days and everyday wear.

name: AEZY 2
description: The next generation of our AEZY system. The same air-feel lightness you know, refined in the lab for a smoother hand and easier movement through the day.

name: FORMLOCK
tagline: For cuts that refuse to sag.
description: A structural construction system. Seam-lock paneling and dense contour knits engineered to hold their silhouette wash after wash, so the cut stays as sharp as day one.

name: FORMLOCK 2
description: The next generation of FORMLOCK. The same shape-holding structure, developed further across more silhouettes, from clean regular cuts to boxy and oversized fits that keep their form.

name: CURFLEX
tagline: For bodies that never sit still.
description: Four-way curve-flex stretch. Moves with your body and recovers its shape for all-day mobility without losing structure. Built to flatter the figure and free the movement.

name: PUFFMAX
tagline: For when soft is the whole point.
description: Maximum loft and density. A plush, cushioned hand that feels like being wrapped in a cloud. Extra-soft and substantial, with comfort that holds up wear after wear.

name: THERCO
tagline: For cold mornings and freezing offices.
description: A thermal comfort system built for cooler hours. Designed to keep warmth close to the body while staying easy to layer and comfortable from morning to night.

name: ANTSHELL
description: An outer-layer system inspired by a lightweight shell. Built to feel light on the body while giving everyday pieces a clean, protective outer face.

name: FLEXE
tagline: For a full range of motion.
description: A flexible system made for full range of motion. Bends and moves with you, then settles back into shape, so the fit feels easy whether you are moving or standing still.

name: MELTWRAP
description: A soft, fluid system that drapes close to the body. Smooth against the skin and light in the hand, it wraps the figure gently for an easy, second-skin feel.
